title: root_dio_signature.py: from_cbor raises KeyError instead of ValueError for missing keys
description:
In RootDioSignaturePayload.from_cbor() lines 151-159, if required keys are missing from the decoded CBOR map, a KeyError is raised with just the numeric key constant (e.g., KeyError: 1). This provides poor error context for debugging.

File: python/src/lichen/crypto/root_dio_signature.py
Lines: 151-159

Failure scenario: CBOR payload missing a required field (e.g., no instance key). Caller sees 'KeyError: 2' with no indication it means 'instance field missing' or which payload type failed.

Fix: Wrap in try/except KeyError and raise ValueError with descriptive message, or use dict.get() with explicit key presence checking.
